# pve_storage_scan_lvm (Data Source)

LVM volume groups discovered by scanning from a node.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_storage_scan_lvm" "example" {
  node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/scan/lvm. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `vg` (String) The LVM logical volume group name.
